result.topic_en: Gauss records the state of his investigation into the transformation (mapping) of surfaces, dated 13 December 1822, deriving relations between the unit normal (A,B,C) and the first and second partial derivatives of the coordinates with respect to parameters t and u.
result.transcription:
Stand meiner Untersuchung über die Umformung der Flächen. Dec. 13. 1822.

$A\partial x + B\partial y + C\partial z = 0$
$AA + BB + CC = 1$
$A' = \frac{\partial A}{\partial t},\ B' = \frac{\partial B}{\partial t},\ C' = \frac{\partial C}{\partial t};\ A'' = \frac{\partial A}{\partial u},\ B'' = \frac{\partial B}{\partial u},\ C'' = \frac{\partial C}{\partial u}$
$a = \frac{\partial x}{\partial t},\ b = \frac{\partial y}{\partial t},\ c = \frac{\partial z}{\partial t};\ \alpha = \frac{\partial x}{\partial u},\ \beta = \frac{\partial y}{\partial u},\ \gamma = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u}$
$a' = \frac{\partial\partial x}{\partial t^2},\ b' = \frac{\partial\partial y}{\partial t^2},\ c' = \frac{\partial\partial z}{\partial t^2};\ a'' = \frac{\partial\partial x}{\partial t.\partial u},\ b'' = \frac{\partial\partial y}{\partial t.\partial u},\ c'' = \frac{\partial\partial z}{\partial t.\partial u}$

$\alpha = cB - bC$
$\beta = aC - cA$
$\gamma = bA - aB$
$aa + bb + cc = \alpha\alpha + \beta\beta + \gamma\gamma = mm$
$aA + bB + cC = 0$
$\alpha A + \beta B + \gamma C = 0$

$a'' = cB' - bC' + Bc' - Cb'$ | $a' = A(Aa' + Bb' + Cc') - Bc'' + Cb''$
$b'' = aC' - cA' + Ca' - Ac'$ | $b' = B(Aa' + Bb' + Cc') - Ca'' + Ac''$
$c'' = bA' - aB' + Ab' - Ba'$ | $c' = C(Aa' + Bb' + Cc') - Ab'' + Ba''$

Man hat ferner hieraus
$Aa'' + Bb'' + Cc'' = -\alpha A' - \beta B' - \gamma C'$
und aus der Differentiation von $aA + bB + cC = 0$ folgt
$Aa'' + Bb'' + Cc'' = -aA'' - bB'' - cC''$ also
$aA'' + bB'' + cC'' = \alpha A' + \beta B' + \gamma C'$ oder
$0 = a(A'' + BC' - CB') + b(B'' + CA' - AC') + c(C'' + AB' - BA')$
welches verbunden mit
$0 = aA + bB + cC$ leicht folgendes gibt

$na = A' + CB'' - BC''$ \quad $n\alpha = A'' + BC' - CB'$
$nb = B' + AC'' - CA''$ \quad $n\beta = B'' + CA' - AC'$
$nc = C' + BA'' - AB''$ \quad $n\gamma = C'' + AB' - BA'$
wo
$mmnn = A'A' + B'B' + C'C' + A''A'' + B''B'' + C''C'' + 2A(B'C'' - C'B'') + 2B(C'A'' - A'C'') + 2C(A'B'' - B'A'')$

Wir haben ferner aus der Differentiation von $a\alpha + b\beta + c\gamma = 0$
$a\alpha' + b\beta' + c\gamma' + \alpha a' + \beta b' + \gamma c' = 0$ oder
$aa'' + bb'' + cc'' + \alpha a' + \beta b' + \gamma c' = 0$ oder
$mm'' + \alpha a' + \beta b' + \gamma c' = 0$ Dies verbunden mit
$aa' + bb' + cc' = mm'$
$Aa' + Bb' + Cc' = -aA' - bB' - cC'$ gibt wenn man resp mit | $\alpha$ \ $a$ \ $mmA$
multiplicirt und addirt
